fixed_input_dimension.encoding: ZZFeatureMap encodes the four inputs on qubits 0-3. Remaining qubits start in |0> and are active workspace qubits: EfficientSU2 applies trainable rotations and linear nearest-neighbor entanglement across the full register, allowing data-bearing and added qubits to interact. No extra classical inputs are added.
fixed_input_dimension.q4_alias: At q=4 this arm is identical to full_system and reuses the same fit.
